venue.name: Veterans Park

keyRules.label: Format
keyRules.value: 7v7 · Max roster 12 · Min 5 to start · Size 4 ball

keyRules.label: Mercy Rule
keyRules.value: 6-goal lead at halftime or later → match ends

keyRules.label: Goal Cap
keyRules.value: Max 4 goals per game for GD and GF tiebreakers

keyRules.label: Substitutions
keyRules.value: Unlimited at goal kicks, throw-ins, kickoffs, halftime, injury

keyRules.label: Heading
keyRules.value: Not allowed U12 and younger → indirect free kick

keyRules.label: Forfeit
keyRules.value: 5 min late (10 min finals). Min 5 players. Recorded as 4-0 loss.

keyRules.label: Zero Tolerance
keyRules.value: No ref abuse — immediate removal + suspension

keyRules.label: Weather
keyRules.value: 30-min delay clock. Post-halftime stoppage = completed game.

keyRules.label: Championship
keyRules.value: No OT — straight to PKs if tied

keyRules.label: Stay-to-Play
keyRules.value: Required for teams 90+ miles. Exception: TDirector@SportingJaxAcademy.com

tiebreakers: Penalty Kicks — FIFA Kicks from the Penalty Mark

updates.title: Stay-to-play booking deadline has passed
updates.description: The Sporting Jax stay-to-play portal now shows the reservation deadline has passed — new bookings are request-only. Cancellations within 7 days of check-in incur a $25 fee; within 72 hours, one night's room rate. The portal's available hotel inventory and rates have also changed since our last update, so review the portal directly for current options before booking. Existing reservations are unaffected.

venueRules.tents: Pop-up canopies allowed. Must be weighted (no stakes in turf fields). Place behind spectator line — not between field and sideline.
venueRules.pets: Veterans Park is pet-friendly. Dogs must be leashed. Clean up after your pet. Not all tournament venues allow pets — check each venue.
venueRules.foodCooler: Outside food and coolers allowed. No glass containers. Concessions available on-site.
venueRules.chairs: Folding chairs allowed along sidelines behind spectator line. Do not block access paths or medical lanes.
venueRules.smoking: Smoking only in designated areas away from fields and playgrounds.
